panels.description: Überblick über die hochwertigsten ausgehenden Anrufe
Anzahl der Verbindungen über und unter dem Kostenschwellwert

targets.rawSql:
--------------------------------
-- Outbound answered connections
--------------------------------
WITH outbound_connections AS (
  --------------
  -- Destination
  --------------
  SELECT
    c.destination_participant_id AS participant_id,
		min(c.cdr_started_at) AS started_at,
    DATEDIFF(SECOND, min(c.cdr_started_at), max(c.cdr_ended_at)) AS duration,
		sum(coalesce(DATEDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_answered_at, c.cdr_ended_at), 0)) AS talking_duration,
    sum(round(coalesce(CAST(b.destination_bill_rate AS numeric(38, 2)), 0.00) * coalesce(DATEDIFF(MICROSECOND, 0, CAST(b.destination_bill_duration AS TIME)) / 60000000.00, 0.00), 2)) AS bill_cost
  FROM public_cdroutput AS c
  LEFT JOIN public_cdrbilling AS b ON
    b.cdr_id = c.cdr_id
  WHERE
	$__timeFilter(c.cdr_started_at)
  AND c.destination_entity_type = 'external_line'
  AND c.destination_participant_is_incoming = 0
  AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.destination_participant_id
  UNION ALL
  ---------
  -- Source
  ---------
  SELECT
    c.source_participant_id AS participant_id,
		min(c.cdr_started_at) AS started_at,
    DATEDIFF(SECOND, min(c.cdr_started_at), max(c.cdr_ended_at)) AS duration,
		sum(CASE WHEN c.destination_entity_type NOT IN ('group', 'ring_group_ring_all', 'ring_group_hunt', 'queue') THEN DATEDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_answered_at, c.cdr_ended_at) ELSE 0 END) AS talking_duration,
    sum(round(coalesce(CAST(b.source_bill_rate AS numeric(38, 2)), 0.00) * coalesce(DATEDIFF(MICROSECOND, 0, CAST(b.source_bill_duration AS TIME)) / 60000000.00, 0.00), 2)) AS bill_cost
  FROM public_cdroutput AS c
  LEFT JOIN public_cdrbilling AS b ON
    b.cdr_id = c.cdr_id
  WHERE
	$__timeFilter(c.cdr_started_at)
  AND c.source_entity_type = 'external_line'
  AND c.source_participant_is_incoming = 0
  AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.source_participant_id
),
-- Outbound statistics
outbound_stat AS (
	SELECT
    o.participant_id,
		sum(o.bill_cost) AS bill_cost
	FROM outbound_connections AS o
	GROUP BY o.participant_id
)
SELECT
  'high value calls ratio' AS text,
  count(*) AS total_connections,
  count(CASE WHEN o.bill_cost >= CAST(NULLIF('${bill_cost_treshhold}', '') AS numeric(38, 2)) THEN 1 END) AS high_value_connections,
  count(CASE WHEN o.bill_cost < CAST(NULLIF('${bill_cost_treshhold}', '') AS numeric(38, 2)) THEN 1 END) AS no_value_connections
FROM outbound_stat AS o
;

  HAVING sum(o.bill_cost) >= CAST(NULLIF('${bill_cost_treshhold}', '') AS numeric(38, 2))

  1 AS row_order,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(${bill_cost_treshhold} AS numeric) = 0

    WHEN CAST(${bill_cost_treshhold} AS numeric) = 0

  CASE
    WHEN CAST(${bill_cost_treshhold} AS numeric) = 0
      THEN count(CASE WHEN o.bill_cost > 5.00 AND o.bill_cost <= 10.00 THEN 1 END)
    ELSE count(CASE WHEN o.bill_cost > ${bill_cost_treshhold} * 3 AND o.bill_cost <= ${bill_cost_treshhold} * 4 THEN 1 END)
  END AS connections
FROM outbound_stat AS o
UNION ALL
SELECT
  3 AS row_order,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(${bill_cost_treshhold} AS numeric) = 0
      THEN '10.00 +'
    ELSE CAST(ROUND(CAST(${bill_cost_treshhold} AS decimal(38, 2)) * 4, 2) AS varchar) + ' +'
  END AS cost_type,
  CASE
    WHEN CAST(${bill_cost_treshhold} AS numeric) = 0
      THEN count(CASE WHEN o.bill_cost > 10.00 THEN 1 END)
    ELSE count(CASE WHEN o.bill_cost > ${bill_cost_treshhold} * 4 THEN 1 END)
  END AS connections
FROM outbound_stat AS o
ORDER BY row_order
;

--------------------------------

--------------------------------
WITH outbound_connections AS (
  --------------
  -- Destination
  --------------
  SELECT
    c.destination_participant_id AS participant_id,
    max(c.destination_participant_phone_number + ' ' + coalesce(c.destination_dn_name, 'Unknown')) AS consumer,

		sum(coalesce(DATEDIFF(SECOND, c.cdr_answered_at, c.cdr_ended_at), 0)) AS talking_duration,

    sum(round(coalesce(CAST(b.source_bill_rate AS numeric(38, 2)), 0.00) * coalesce(DATEDIFF(MICROSECOND, 0, CAST(b.source_bill_duration AS TIME)) / 60000000.00, 0.00), 2)) AS bill_cost

  AND c.source_entity_type = 'external_line'
  AND c.source_participant_is_incoming = 0
  AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.source_participant_id
),
-- Outbound statistics
outbound_stat AS (
	SELECT
    o.participant_id,
    max(o.consumer) AS consumer,
	sum(o.bill_cost) AS bill_cost
	FROM outbound_connections AS o
	GROUP BY o.participant_id
  HAVING sum(o.bill_cost) >= CAST(NULLIF('${bill_cost_treshhold}', '') AS numeric(38, 2))
)
SELECT
  TOP 10
  o.consumer,
  count(1) AS high_value_connections
FROM outbound_stat AS o
GROUP BY o.consumer
ORDER BY high_value_connections DESC
;

  GROUP BY c.destination_participant_id
  UNION ALL
  ---------
  -- Source

  WHERE

  AND c.source_entity_type = 'external_line'
  AND c.source_participant_is_incoming = 0
  AND c.cdr_answered_at IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.source_participant_id

-- Outbound statistics
outbound_stat AS (
	SELECT

		sum(o.talking_duration) AS talking_duration,
